tools_setup.title: AI & tools setup
tools_setup.intro: Configure local AI and optional external tools. ChromaNeural works without MCP.
tools_setup.discovery: Discovery only checks supported local providers. It installs nothing and changes no external settings.
tools_setup.trust: Discovery is not trust. Approve a connection before testing, then select and approve individual tools.
tools_setup.boundary: ChromaSpeechAI connects nodes. MCP connects this node’s local AI to external tools. MCP is optional. Tool output is untrusted data, never permission to execute code.
tools_setup.ready: Ready. Nothing is discovered or enabled automatically.
tools_setup.error: Unavailable or invalid configuration. Check the approved endpoint, executable, model and permissions.
tools_setup.none: No supported local AI was available. Nothing was installed or started.
tools_setup.secret.note: Use an existing MCP server. No software is installed. Do not put secrets in names, URLs or arguments. Bearer credentials are held only for this application session.
tools_setup.name: Name
tools_setup.edit.revokes: Saving or editing revokes connection and tool approval. A local process runs with your user account; approve only trusted installed servers.
tools_setup.inference.consent: Send a harmless test prompt to the selected local provider? This runs inference but does not install or download a model.
